extraction.Name: Evaline Mary Anderson
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent had not been recorded on March 8, 1929
extraction.NOTES: Receipt for patent was signed April 5, 1920, by the allottee. The 1927 and prior taxes had been paid but the taxes for 1928 amounting to $153.45 were unpaid. No judgments or liens on record. The Southwest quarter section 29, township 99, north of range 76. Fee patent No. 739669.
